location.site: Southern Virginia Megasite at Berry Hill
location.address_or_corridor: Berry Hill Road / US Route 311 area, less than 10 miles west of Danville

status_as_of_cutoff: local process / economic-development agreement authorized as of 2026-08-11. Official May 18, 2026 RIFA minutes confirm a 4-0 vote on Resolution 2026-05-18-4A authorizing negotiation, execution, and delivery of a Local Performance Agreement with SAC III Acquisition Co., LLC for a STACK-affiliated digital-infrastructure campus at the Southern Virginia Megasite at Berry Hill. Local reporting later says the fully executed LPA was ratified in July 2026 and that the project is proceeding after Virginia retained data-center tax exemptions, but no site plan, building permit, environmental permit, utility interconnection approval, construction start, energized load, or tenant/customer was found.

actions.action_type: purchase and sale agreement / land disposition
actions.result_status: Official CivicClerk search result identifies a March 9, 2026 RIFA meeting attachment for Resolution 2026-03-09 and SAC III Acquisition Co., LLC. Local reporting says RIFA entered an agreement for SAC III to buy Tract HK and obtain options on additional megasite parcels, totaling up to 2,990 acres at $238,000 per acre; Phase 1 was described as at least 1,000 acres.
actions.access_caveat: CivicClerk attachment page requires JavaScript in direct browser view; the search index exposed the official attachment text. Local corroboration: https://www.wakg.com/2026/03/09/danville-pittsylvania-rifa-approves-sale-of-land-at-megasite-to-company-affiliated-with-data-centers/.
actions.evidence_note: Land sale / option agreement is not a construction approval.

actions.result_status: Official minutes confirm approval of Resolution 2026-05-18-4A authorizing negotiation, execution, and delivery of an LPA connected to the March 9, 2026 purchase and sale agreement. The minutes state SAC3 would commit to at least $100 billion in capital investments over a 30-year performance period and at least 2,500 FTE new jobs over a 20-year performance period with annual compensation of at least $80,500, subject to COLA.
actions.vote_tally: 4-0; AYE Ingram, Tucker, Saunders, Vogler; NAY none
actions.access_caveat: Official PDF minutes were retrievable through the CivicClerk API endpoint; signed LPA text was not retrieved.
actions.evidence_note: Performance agreement is an economic-development action, not a construction permit or site approval.

actions.government_body: Virginia General Assembly / Commonwealth budget context
actions.result_status: Cardinal News reported that Stack said the Berry Hill project would continue to advance through its competitive site-selection process after Virginia finalized a budget retaining existing data-center sales-and-use-tax exemptions through 2035, with a separate Pittsylvania-specific exemption reported as running to at least 2040 if criteria are met.
actions.access_caveat: Company/state-budget update from local reporting; not a local construction approval.
actions.evidence_note: This reduces a reported deal contingency but does not establish construction status.

actions.government_body: Pittsylvania County Board of Supervisors / RIFA
actions.action_type: reported ratification of fully executed LPA and county project approval
actions.result_status: WBTM reported that the Pittsylvania County Board of Supervisors approved the economic-development project on July 21, 2026 and that RIFA had unanimously ratified the fully executed LPA the prior week. The same report said the project had been accepted into Virginia's Expedited Permitting Program.
actions.vote_tally: unanimous RIFA ratification reported by WBTM; official minutes not retrieved
actions.access_caveat: Local reporting located; official July RIFA/BOS minutes and executed LPA were not retrieved in this run.
actions.evidence_note: Treat as economic-development/LPA status until official records or permits are located.

actions.action_type: scheduled public hearing for data-center machinery and tools tax rate
actions.result_status: Official county notice schedules a public hearing for proposed adoption of a separate rate for qualifying data-center computer equipment, peripherals, and software at $1.62 per $100 of assessed value.
actions.access_caveat: Future hearing as of the 2026-08-11 refresh; no adoption vote found yet.
actions.evidence_note: The tax rate is proposed/scheduled, not confirmed adopted as of cutoff.

sources.match_reason: Exact Phase3↔regional stable-ID pair; seed merged only with explicit evidence

contradictions.description: March reporting described 2,050 jobs and DCD described a $73.5B minimum investment / 2,050-job performance floor, while official May 18 minutes and later local reporting describe $100B over 30 years and 2,500 FTE jobs over 20 years. Record uses the official May 18 minutes for current LPA terms and preserves the earlier figures as lower-bound/earlier-reporting context.

May reporting described the $1.62 per $100 data-center equipment tax rate as expected or tied to the project; the official Pittsylvania County notice found on 2026-08-11 schedules an August 18, 2026 public hearing for proposed adoption. Record treats the tax rate as proposed/scheduled, not adopted, until an official vote is found.
